capabilities.containment: Windows Job Object (backend assigned during creation)

accessibility.scope: AccessKit AT-SPI or UI Automation; presence does not qualify screen-reader journeys

attention.scope: Window-manager policy; Wayland requires xdg-activation and cannot cancel urgency

clipboard_text.scope: Text only; availability is established by the native request

external_open.scope: Optional parent forwarded to OpenURI or Windows Shell; accepted is not proof of a presented app

file_dialogs.scope: Parented native picker; Linux requires the desktop portal

ime.scope: Composition, surrounding text and candidate area depend on the active input method

ime_purpose_hints.scope: Advisory Wayland input purpose/hints; pinned winit does not implement these hints on Windows

incoming_drop.scope: Bounded local file or text data, with document target policy

native_preferences.scope: Observed color scheme, reduced motion and high contrast; missing per-setting values stay null

reveal_file.scope: Local path selection via FileManager1.ShowItems or Windows Shell; these services have no parent argument

window_constraints.scope: Paired min/max CSS-pixel bounds; OS may impose additional limits

window_focus.scope: Wayland focus is compositor-owned; use advisory attention

window_observation.scope: Native observed state; unavailable properties are null, separate from requested state

window_visibility.scope: Pinned Wayland backend cannot create hidden windows or show/hide existing top levels

capabilities.legacy_flags: Top-level service booleans describe enabled API surfaces; feature availability below is authoritative and null means unobserved

native_preferences.scope: observed native preferences; document application overrides take precedence

qualification.evidence: No native qualification is inferred from compiled code, a previous release, or an available service
